steps.prompt: Warm-up: which line starts two calls so that their waits overlap?
options: `var a = A(); var b = B(); await Task.WhenAll(a, b);`
`var a = await A(); var b = await B();`
steps.explain: Calling an async method starts it. Awaiting it right away waits before the next one starts; keeping the tasks and awaiting them together lets both run.
